integer_output_policy: Set Python's exact integer conversion limit to the declared bounded value; rational serialization also checks the active bit cap before rendering. 16384 bits require at most 4934 decimal digits plus margin.
partial_slab_policy: enclose exp(A*tau) for all tau in [0,h] by interval Taylor terms and an outward symmetric norm tail; endpoint uses tau=h and carries the resulting interval to the next slab
parameter_policy: same complete exact label cell and label order reused unchanged on every slab; no parameter subdivision or reset
unknown_policy: return UNKNOWN or RESOURCE_UNKNOWN on failed branch, margin, arithmetic cap, wall limit, memory limit, output cap, or unsupported input; preserve row and reason
